slowest_experiments.experiment: Measure adapter-withheld ARC with durable episode evidence
Measure certified memory independently on sealed synthetic streams
Audit synthetic and live proof claims independently
Qualify durable ARC episodes across timeout and restart
Qualify current-work receipts and the assignment reducer

summary: All 11 completed experiments were compute-bound and occupied 39.8 minutes. Measure adapter-withheld ARC with durable episode evidence was the critical path at 30.8 minutes, but the supplied data does not identify its costly phase; the locked compute-task GPU-idle classification is false.
bottlenecks_identified: Critical-path concentration: Measure adapter-withheld ARC with durable episode evidence took 30.8 of the 39.8 minutes, while the supplied timing data does not identify which internal phase caused the delay.
The disk-mtime reconstruction lacks per-phase spans, so setup, inference, waiting, validation, and persistence costs cannot be separated.
The GPU snapshot is not synchronized to individual experiment windows, so sustained compute utilization cannot be graded even though no compute-task GPU-idle fault is recorded.
Model-count and runner-dispatch receipts are absent, so no eligible parallel-model DualGPURunner miss can be established.
improvements_suggested: Emit one task-scoped execution receipt that joins phase start and stop times with process, device, periodic GPU-utilization, model-count, and runner-dispatch metadata.
Add restartable phase checkpoints and explicit wait-state labels to the adapter-withheld ARC durable-episode workflow so its critical path can be resumed and attributed.
Schedule independent eligible compute work on an available second GPU when concurrency and memory permit, while retaining single-GPU execution for a single-model task.
Run a measured baseline-versus-instrumented comparison before assigning nonzero time savings to these changes.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the adapter-withheld ARC durable-episode workflow with phase timing, wait-state labels, and restartable checkpoints.
Join experiment windows to GPU samples and record process, model-count, runner, and device decisions in the same receipt.
Add a scheduler path for independent eligible work to use an available second GPU without forcing DualGPURunner on single-model tasks.
meta_reflection: The timing list identifies the critical path but not its cause, and the closing GPU snapshot cannot substitute for task-window telemetry. With no measured counterfactual for the proposed tooling, the savings estimate remains 0%.
